sentences: A linear circuit shares partial sums to compute a matrix transformation over a specified operation system.
Restricting it to depth two allows only one intermediate layer.
The source asks how much this restriction can increase circuit complexity, with different behavior for OR, SUM, and XOR operations.
Known separations leave room for stronger gaps, particularly over the binary field.
The project seeks to quantify the value of additional computational layers even when the final transformation is algebraically simple.
